The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (3 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.
